name: Spray
desc: The fine mist of flying droplets thrown up where water breaks.
prose: You are the spray - the fine mist of flying droplets thrown up where water breaks. The wave smashes the rock and you burst into the air; the hose, the wave, the waterfall all fling you out in a cloud of tiny drops. You catch the sun and make a little rainbow, then settle wet and cool on every face nearby. Too fine to call rain, too wet to call air, you are the sea flung up in pieces.

lines: Jump in the puddle with both your feet
a big wet noisy scatter of drops -
The sound of water swaying round
in a bucket as you walk;
it spills a little over the side -
The huge salt water, wide and deep,
where the waves roll in to land;
ships sail on it, whales swim in it -
The sound a stone makes in a pond,
or a raindrop in a cup;
down it drops and - ___! - it's gone,
